gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Tall, stencil-straight and unmistakable, Unica One draws every stroke at a single thickness with a huge lowercase eye. Noto Sans PhagsPa sits beside it as a plain sans, friendly and see-through, softening all that command.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Unica One has no tapering at all, so each stroke looks cut by a machine rather than pressed by a quill. And Noto Sans Phoenician follows in a plain sans with generous height and wide-open s curves, which would keep a long read easy.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pa: Unica One looks like sign-shop vinyl cut to a single line width, with big round counters showing daylight. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi sits under it as a sans with gaping e mouths and barely rising capitals, so the page feels firm on top and relaxed below.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang opens its lowercase counters like wide glass portholes, with distinct gaps in c, e, s and a. Over it, Unica One bends its strokes like steel rod.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic reads big and tight, a tall x-height with little ascender room and curves that never close on themselves. But Unica One above it keeps a ruler-straight line weight, so a long page would feel crisp rather than crowded.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Heavy bars, heavy stems, all of it uniform: Unica One makes horizontals exactly as hefty as its uprights, with daylight in every curve. Noto Sans Samaritan adds a sturdy sans below.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Unica One keeps every bar at identical thickness. Noto Sans Saurashtra then follows as a plain sans whose capitals barely stand above their neighbors and whose counters stay connected to the outside, so the heading carries the drama while the text simply gets on with it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-sc: Rigid and pressure-free, Unica One turns each corner without any swell, so the curves stay crisp and wide. Noto Sans SC stays low and plain sans beneath.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Sharp and signlike, Unica One runs a single stroke width through the whole alphabet, with big daylight in the curves. But Noto Sans Sharada gives it a bulkier plain sans below, with open c forms that never close into rings.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Noto Sans Siddham carries a large central band in the text line, and an s whose ends hang far from its spine. Unica One sits above in single-thickness outlines, a firm sans-serif contrast.
